name: Workout Tracker - Beat It
dev: David Johannes Maximiliaan van den Pol

ios.desc:
Know what to beat before your next set. Log your weights and reps, see your previous performance, and build your next workout around real progress.

Beat It is a workout tracker for strength training. Keep your gym log, routines, and lifting goals together, without guessing what you did last time.

LOG EVERY WORKING SET
Record weight and reps for each exercise. Optionally add reps in reserve (RIR) to capture how much you had left. Compare sessions and keep your rest timer close while you train.

PLAN YOUR OWN ROUTINES
Build workout routines with your exercises, sets, and rep targets. Bring your plan to the gym and record what you actually complete.

YOUR DATA. YOUR NEXT STEP.
Beat It uses its own progressive overload algorithm, developed with insights from strength-training research. Your logged performance informs personalized suggestions for weight, reps, and rest. Recommendations are estimates, not guarantees of results.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
An extra rep or a heavier lift can be a meaningful step forward. Review your exercise history and follow changes in your performance over time.

WORK TOWARD A CLEAR TARGET
Choose the weight and reps you want to reach. Goal Path shows your progress and an estimated next milestone based on your logged training.

GO FURTHER WITH BEAT IT PRO
The free version lets you log workouts and use two routines. Beat It Pro is a paid subscription with additional routines, full training history, and temporary training programs for a confirmed plateau.

Start with your next set. Build on what you did last time.
